INSERT INTO mbie_directorships (citizen_id, nzbn, entity_name, role, appointed_date)
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
           ON CONFLICT (citizen_id, nzbn, appointed_date) DO UPDATE SET
              entity_name = EXCLUDED.entity_name,
              role = EXCLUDED.role
           RETURNING (xmax = 0) AS inserted
